label: CBFB::MYH11

sections.text: CBFB encodes the non-DNA-binding beta subunit of the core-binding factor transcription complex.
MYH11 encodes smooth-muscle myosin heavy chain, a contractile motor protein.

The inv(16)/t(16;16) fusion alters CBFB interaction with RUNX1 and core-binding factor transcription, impairing myeloid differentiation. It is associated with AML showing myelomonocytic differentiation and abnormal eosinophils.
Under adult ELN 2022 intensive-treatment criteria, CBFB::MYH11 AML is assigned to the favorable genetic-risk group.
